def count_rotation(arr):
    """Return how many left rotations turn a sorted array into arr.

    The count is the index of the first descent. A rotated sorted array
    decreases at exactly that pivot; an already sorted array returns 0.
    """
    for i in range(1, len(arr)):
        if arr[i] < arr[i - 1]:
            return i
    return 0
